items.title: Lou Pallo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2007
items.q: if you’re going to play with Jimmy I’ll bring my 335

ctx.x: You have to wait for someone to call you for that gig. So that’s why I keep changing every — and then I use the different guitars. That’s how, if you’re going to play with Jimmy I’ll bring my 335 or I might bring an acoustic with electric of course on it. And with Keith I bring a Les Paul, and so forth. Oh the Squirrel Nut Zippers, have you ever heard of them?
